facebook:
The week started with a loss I'd planned for.

Tuesday morning I sold ES during New York hours, and my risk was a 4 point hard stop from my entry price. Price ran into it, and the fill came half a point worse: 4.5 points gone. That was the risk I'd defined before entry.

I went short again right after, and that one closed 15 points in my favor. Three more trades followed over Tuesday night and Wednesday, and all of them closed green.

By Wednesday's close: 5 real trades, 4 winners, 1 loser, +64.5 points added across every contract, before fees. A paper trade on Monday made 13.75, and it stays out of that count.

Thanksgiving was Thursday. On Friday's shortened session I stayed flat.

What matters more to you, the size of your biggest loss or how many trades you win?
